lines.zh: 三米半的身体一动，地就响
lines.en: My 3.5-meter frame moves and the ground answers.
One stride of mine covers three of yours.

lines.zh: 脚掌落地，草被压出一个坑
lines.en: My foot lands and presses a hollow in the grass.

lines.zh: 我抱着手臂走，像在丈量
lines.en: I walk with arms crossed, as if measuring.
The heavy armor knocks dully at my shoulders.

lines.zh: 我从这里走到那里，就够你跑
lines.en: My one walk is your whole run.

lines.zh: 斗篷在身后拖出一道痕
lines.en: My cloak drags a line behind me.
I stoop to pass the low trees.

lines.zh: 巨大的脚把石头踩进土里
lines.en: My huge foot drives a stone into soil.
I walk steadily, never stumbling.
As I lift a foot, my shadow sweeps you.
One stride carries me over the whole brook.

lines.zh: 我站着，像一座带角的山
lines.en: I stand like a horned mountain.

lines.zh: 手臂上的甲片反着冷光
lines.en: The plates on my arm throw cold light.
I do not move; only breath.

lines.zh: 三米半的高度，看得见远处
lines.en: At three and a half meters I see far.

lines.zh: 我等一个值得动手的对手
lines.en: I wait for a worthy opponent.
Wind passes between my horns.

lines.zh: 我把手指一节一节伸直
lines.en: I straighten my fingers one joint at a time.
I never sweat beneath the armor.
I tip my head to distant sounds.
My shadow wraps around me.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转动手腕，试关节
lines.en: I rotate my wrist slowly, testing the joint.

lines.zh: 角上缠着的布已经旧了
lines.en: The cloth wrapped on my horn has gone old.

lines.zh: 我抬起下巴，望向更远处
lines.en: I lift my chin and look further off.
There is a low echo inside the armor.
I must lower my head to see you.
You stand at the height of my knee.

lines.zh: 我把你从头到脚看了一遍
lines.en: I look you over from head to toe.
Something so small dares to come.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸吹乱了你的头发
lines.en: My breath ruffles your hair.
I raise one hand to compare.
You take two steps back; I have not moved.

lines.zh: 你的武器在我眼里像根针
lines.en: Your weapon looks like a needle to me.
I crouch a little to look closer.

lines.zh: 我把头转向你，角对着你
lines.en: I turn my head, horns toward you.
If you challenge me, say it.

lines.zh: 我把手掌撑在膝上，弯下腰
lines.en: I brace a palm on my knee and bend.

lines.zh: 你的声音传到我这，很轻
lines.en: Your voice reaches me very faintly.
I turn aside to move my shadow off you.
I search you for ki.
Your joints are creaking; you are afraid.

lines.zh: 我很好奇你哪来的胆子
lines.en: I wonder where you found the nerve.
I lower my head level with yours.
A white mark is cut into my armor.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，地面震了一下
lines.en: I give half a step and the ground jolts.
The blow found my armor's seam.
I clench my teeth; my breath grows rough.
My knee bends for an instant.
My fingers barely lift.
I growl low.
Blood drips from under the armor into the soil.
I lower my body to steady myself.

lines.zh: 我的角歪了一点，我扶正
lines.en: My horn is askew; I set it right.

lines.zh: 那么小一块东西，够谁吃
lines.en: So small a morsel; who could eat that?
I can fight without eating.
But the smell is not bad.
Held up that high, I cannot see it.
I lay my palm on the ground.
Put it here so I can taste.
I lower my head and my breath sweeps you.
Not enough to fill a tooth gap.
I will not take it; I wait for you to offer.
Eat first; the fight can wait.

lines.zh: 你撞上我的小腿，像撞树
lines.en: You hit my shin like a tree trunk.
I shift a foot and you are pushed aside.
My knee knocks your shoulder.
You bounce off me.

lines.zh: 我低头看被你撞的地方
lines.en: I look down where you hit.
The impact rings like a struck bell.
Half a step back from me shakes the ground.
You cannot grip me; the armor is too smooth.

lines.zh: 我抬手挡了一下，没用力
lines.en: I raise a hand to block without effort.

lines.zh: 你的头顶撞到我的膝盖
lines.en: Your head strikes my knee.

lines.zh: 她和我一样高，站在一起像两座塔
lines.en: She is my height; together we are two towers.

lines.zh: 我们不说话，只用角轻碰
lines.en: No words; our horns touch lightly.
She settles my shoulder plate.
Two heavy armors breathe slowly.

lines.zh: 我们并肩看同一个方向
lines.en: We look the same way, side by side.
Her palm is broader than mine.

lines.zh: 我们约好，谁赢了谁先走
lines.en: We agree: the winner walks first.

lines.zh: 夜里我们靠在一起取暖
lines.en: At night we lean together for warmth.

lines.zh: 她笑的时候，地面轻轻震
lines.en: When she laughs, the ground trembles.

lines.zh: 我们的影子在地上叠成一座山
lines.en: Our shadows stack into a hill.
I bend, slower than expected.
Two fingers lift the thing.

lines.zh: 我把石头在掌心转了转
lines.en: I roll the stone in my palm.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的树，我扶起来
lines.en: I set the fallen tree back upright.
I pick up a broken spear.

lines.zh: 手掌里的东西小得像米
lines.en: It sits in my palm as small as rice.
I drop it into the pouch at my waist.

lines.zh: 我拾起一根压断的树枝
lines.en: I pick up a snapped branch.

lines.zh: 我跪下一条腿，才能捡到
lines.en: I go down on one knee to reach it.

lines.zh: 我把东西放在掌心看了看
lines.en: I set it in my palm and study it.
I raise my head and nail my gaze to you.
I take one stride and the ground booms.
You are already beneath me.
Three and a half meters bears down.
I raise my arm and close it into a fist.

lines.zh: 你抬手前，我已经在你侧面。
lines.en: Before you raise a hand, I am already at your side.

lines.zh: 我不需要加速，走过去就行
lines.en: I need no speed; walking will do.
Wind begins to circle me.
I sink my weight and bend my knees.
I lower my horns forward.

lines.zh: 你站在那儿，还不知道自己输了
lines.en: You stand there not knowing you have lost.
I lift a foot, then set it down slowly.

lines.zh: 我把拳头握紧，甲片咬合
lines.en: I clench my fist and the plates lock.

lines.zh: 周围的气开始往我这边流
lines.en: The ki around begins to flow toward me.
When I speak, my voice is like stone.
I have planted my foot across your retreat.

lines.zh: 我一步一步跟着你，从不跑
lines.en: I follow step by step; I never run.

lines.zh: 你跑到哪儿，我一步就到
lines.en: Wherever you run, one stride reaches.
My shadow covers you first.
You look up and there I am.
I open my palm to grab.
My foot blocks your path.
I am patient; you cannot outrun me.

lines.zh: 我抬起另一只手，堵住那边
lines.en: I raise the other hand to block that side.
You are between my arms.
My breath makes the air heavy.

lines.zh: 我蹲下来，把你逼到墙角
lines.en: I crouch and press you into the corner.

lines.zh: 你再退半步，就没有地方了
lines.en: Half a step more and you have nowhere.

lines.zh: 我伸手在你的头顶上方
lines.en: I reach out above your head.

lines.zh: 我不需要看，也听得到你
lines.en: I need not look; I hear you.

lines.zh: 你换了几次方向，都一样
lines.en: You have changed direction several times; it changes nothing.

lines.zh: 我把膝盖压到地上，围住你
lines.en: I drop a knee to the ground and wall you in.

lines.zh: 我的手影把你整个罩住
lines.en: The shadow of my hand covers all of you.

lines.zh: 我一步一步把圈子收紧
lines.en: Step by step I tighten the circle.
My fist comes down like a falling rock.
A small ki blast snaps from my palm.
A kick sweeps you off your feet.

lines.zh: 手掌拍下，土被拍得飞起
lines.en: My palm slams down and soil flies up.
I seize your shoulder and hurl you.

lines.zh: 你挡得住一拳，挡不住第二拳
lines.en: You stop one fist, not the second.

lines.zh: 气功波贴着地面推过去。
lines.en: My ki wave skims the floor toward you.
I bring my elbow down.
You fall far back from my fist.
My fist grazes your head.

lines.zh: 你举手臂格挡，骨头响了
lines.en: You block with an arm, and bone cracks.
I hammer down two fists in a row.
I reach out and seize your collar.

lines.zh: 我一掌推出，气功波掀起地面。
lines.en: I thrust a palm and the ki wave tears up the ground.

lines.zh: 我一脚把你踢到树干上
lines.en: One kick sends you into a trunk.
My palm slaps in from the side.

lines.zh: 我的角先从阴影里出来
lines.en: My horns emerge from the shadow first.

lines.zh: 我踏出一步，四周的树晃了
lines.en: I take one step and the trees sway.
I straighten to three and a half meters.

lines.zh: 铠甲上还带着封印的尘
lines.en: Seal dust still clings to my armor.

lines.zh: 我把手臂抬起，握了握拳
lines.en: I lift an arm and clench it.

lines.zh: 我低头看这片陌生的地
lines.en: I look down at this unfamiliar ground.
A dull thunder sounds far off.

lines.zh: 我从地下站起来，土在滑落
lines.en: I rise from the earth and soil slides off.
I throw my cloak behind me.
My arrival scatters all the birds.
Standing here, I am taller than the trees.

lines.zh: 我抬起一只脚，踩碎石头
lines.en: I lift one foot and crush a stone.
The seal's chains lie broken on the ground.

lines.zh: 我把肩膀转了转，甲在响
lines.en: I roll my shoulders and the armor speaks.
I open my eyes and see this sky.
My steps set the puddles rippling.
I walk slowly into this clearing.
My name is carved in stone.

lines.zh: 火在我甲上烧，烫得钻心
lines.en: Fire burns on my armor, searing deep.

lines.zh: 我从高处落地，膝盖先撞上
lines.en: I land from height, knees striking first.

lines.zh: 水没到我的胸口，气被压住
lines.en: Water reaches my chest and presses my breath.

lines.zh: 爆风把我推得退了两步
lines.en: The blast shoves me back two steps.

lines.zh: 箭卡在肩甲缝里，像根小刺。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my shoulder seam like a splinter.
That magic coils around my horns.

lines.zh: 饿着肚子，这具身体也变沉
lines.en: Hungry, even this body grows heavy.

lines.zh: 雷打在我角上，一路窜到脚
lines.en: Lightning strikes my horns and runs to my feet.

lines.zh: 脚下没有地，我抓着空气
lines.en: No ground below; I clutch at air.
